question: If the employee leaves employment and wants to continue coverage without a medical exam, which option is appropriate — conversion or portability?
expected_answer: Both conversion and portability are available without evidence of insurability. Conversion provides an individual whole life policy up to $200,000; portability continues the same group amount at age-banded rates.
evidence: 5.1 If your group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, you may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability. / 6.5 Evidence of insurability is NOT required for portability.

goal_plan.reasoning: The query asks about two specific options—conversion and portability—in the context of continuing health insurance coverage after leaving employment, without requiring a medical exam. This is a factual, domain-specific question about employee benefits terminology. The key is to determine which of the two terms (conversion or portability) allows continuation of coverage without a medical exam. This requires understanding the definitions and conditions of each option in group health insurance plans. Since the answer hinges on distinguishing between two related but distinct concepts, the query is not a simple lookup but requires comparing two defined terms. However, the core task is to identify which one applies under the specified condition (no medical exam), so the sub-goals should first define both terms and then compare them based on the no-exam requirement.

goals: Define the term 'conversion' in the context of group health insurance plans
Define the term 'portability' in the context of group health insurance plans
Determine which of the two options—conversion or portability—allows continuation of coverage without a medical exam

candidates.path_text: "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege." -> The right to convert group coverage to an individual policy upon termination (except for non-payment) is a shared provision across both documents. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability." -> The lack of evidence of insurability required for portability aligns with the conversion privilege that does not require such evidence. -> "Evidence of insurability is not required for portability."

"If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege." -> The right to convert group coverage to an individual policy upon termination (except for non-payment) is a shared provision across both documents. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability." -> The provision allowing conversion to an individual policy without evidence of insurability is a key feature of porting coverage after leaving employment. -> "Premiums for ported coverage are payable directly to the insurance company."

"If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege." -> The right to convert group coverage to an individual policy upon termination (except for non-payment) is a shared provision across both documents. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability." -> The absence of pre-existing condition exclusions supports the ability to convert without evidence of insurability. -> "Group coverage has no pre-existing condition exclusions."

"If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege." -> The right to convert group coverage to an individual policy upon termination (except for non-payment) is a shared provision across both documents. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability." -> The lack of health questions is a direct feature of the conversion process that allows for no evidence of insurability. -> "No health questions are required for conversion to an individual whole life policy."

"If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege." -> The right to convert group coverage to an individual policy upon termination (except for non-payment) is a shared provision across both documents. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability." -> The requirement to apply for conversion within a specific timeframe is a direct consequence of the condition under which conversion is permitted. -> "The individual must apply for conversion within 31 days of termination of group coverage."

"If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege." -> The right to convert group coverage to an individual policy upon termination (except for non-payment) is a shared provision across both documents. -> "If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may convert to an individual whole life policy without evidence of insurability." -> The maximum coverage amount for the conversion policy is limited by either the original group coverage or a fixed cap. -> "The maximum amount for the conversion policy is the lesser of the group coverage amount or $200,000."

"If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege." -> Termination due to cessation of full-time employment triggers the right to convert coverage. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual ceases active full-time employment." -> Basic group life insurance coverage terminates when an individual ceases active full-time employment, which is a key condition for coverage duration. -> "Basic coverage became effective automatically without requiring evidence of insurability."

"If group coverage terminates for any reason except non-payment of premium, the individual may exercise a conversion privilege." -> Termination due to cessation of full-time employment triggers the right to convert coverage. -> "Coverage terminates on the earliest of the following: the date the individual ceases active full-time employment." -> Coverage termination upon cessation of full-time employment triggers the 31-day window to apply for conversion. -> "The individual must apply for conversion within 31 days of termination of group coverage."
